title: Decision readiness - one row per requirement in the owner brief

status_legend.Built: Exists and is verified for the scope stated
status_legend.Partial: Exists for part of the scope; the gate named in the row still applies
status_legend.Framework: Design or specification only; no computed numbers
status_legend.Blocked: Cannot proceed until the named gate is cleared
status_legend.Decided: A decision was recorded (including rejections); nothing to build yet
